lines.en: I drift forward through the sea.
This amphibian body does not mind the water.
One flick of a fin and I glide.
Seaweed hangs on my shell.
The seafloor sand is fine.
I travel right along the sand.

lines.zh: 水面上的光在我背上一格一格。
lines.en: Light on the surface slides block by block across my back.
I know this stretch well.
I look for food as I go.

lines.zh: 我顺着珊瑚边上游，鳍轻轻摆。
lines.en: I swim along the coral rim, fins waving.
My fins make very little sound.
A cold current runs under the surface.
I halt in the water.
The water passes by me.
I need not surface to breathe.
This sea is very quiet.
I listen to the current.
My belly feels hollow.
There is not much to eat here.
The kelp sways slowly.
I sway along as well.
There is a flat stone on the bottom.
I settle onto it.
I hear a boat.
The sound is far away.
There is no boat on this water.
You are standing on the shore.
Your shadow lies on the water.
I drift beneath your shadow.
You will not see me.
In the water, I am like a kite.

lines.zh: 现在你看见了，就别想上岸。
lines.en: Now that you see me, do not hope for shore.
I am neither fish nor man.
You crouch on the shore changing boots.
The water has reached your socks.

lines.zh: 水面下有我，你没注意到。
lines.en: I am under the surface, and you have not noticed.
I lift my head above the surface.

lines.zh: 你在船上低头，终于看见我了。
lines.en: Leaning over the boat, you finally see me.
Your boots are sunk in wet sand.
It takes effort to pull them free.
I wait for you to pull free.
You shade your eyes with a hand.
The water around me clouds.

lines.zh: 我这对鳍在水里，比在岸上顺。
lines.en: These fins work better in water than on land.
There is a mark on my shell.

lines.zh: 伤口渗着蓝光，我还游得动。
lines.en: Blue light seeps from the wound; I can still swim.

lines.zh: 浮上水面换口气，我又沉下去。
lines.en: I surface for a breath and sink again.

lines.zh: 我缩进礁石缝里，等你过来。
lines.en: I squeeze behind the reef and wait for you.
My fins slap twice.
I sink to the bed and let the water shield me.
I brush the kelp off my shell.

lines.zh: 海里的我，缩进壳里一点。
lines.en: In the sea, I pull back into my shell.
You have seafood in your hand.

lines.zh: 那味道一下就到水里了。
lines.en: That smell reached the water at once.
I have come up first.
Just throw it in the water.
I will catch it there.
Do not move on the shore.
You hold it up on the shore.
I cannot climb the shore.
Crouching down was right.
Crouch lower yet.
You threw it into the shallows.
I am swimming over.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，退了几步。
lines.en: You bumped into me and stepped back.
I am wet; do not mind.

lines.zh: 我让开半步，水纹推到你脚上。
lines.en: I give way and my wake pushes at your feet.
Your footing is wet sand.
The water pushes you back a step.
That was my fin.
I swim to your flank.

lines.zh: 我从你腿边滑过，鳞片冰凉。
lines.en: I slide past your legs, scales cold.
Your body trembled once.

lines.zh: 我碰了你一下，水花溅起来。
lines.en: I brushed you and water splashed up.

lines.zh: 海这么大，我也没遇上几个。
lines.en: The sea is vast and I have met few.
Such things wait on the tide.
There is no courting in the sea.
We only follow the tide.
The season you ask about is wrong.

lines.zh: 我连自己是怎么进化的都不知道。
lines.en: I do not even know how I evolved.
I live with the sea.
Mention nothing else at all.

lines.zh: 我们之间的差别太大了。
lines.en: The difference between us is too great.

lines.zh: 问这个不如问我海有多深。
lines.en: Asking that is like asking how deep the sea is.
There is something on the seabed.
I sink down to look.
It is a shell.
I carry it up.
There is something inside the shell.
I crack it open.

lines.zh: 我用鳍把它扫进石头缝。
lines.en: I sweep it into a crevice with my fin.
It has floated up.
I press it down with a fin.
Round as I am, I float on the surface.

lines.zh: 你的脚踏进海水，我听见了。
lines.en: Your foot enters the water and I hear it.

lines.zh: 这片海床归我，你也归我。
lines.en: This seabed is mine, and so are you.

lines.zh: 你踩进水里，就没退路了。
lines.en: You stepped into the water; no way back.
You are slow in the water.
Not in this water, I will not.
Your boots have filled with water.
Every step is heavier.
I need not surface.
The sand under you is collapsing.
I have muddied the water.
You cannot see your footing now.

lines.zh: 你再往前就到我这边了。
lines.en: One step more and you are on my side.
I circle you underwater.
Your hands swing in the water.
In the water it is useless.

lines.zh: 水流会替我把你的动作拖慢。
lines.en: The water drags your movements for me.
I wait for your legs to fill with water.
I am in the water at your feet.
The water is murky; you cannot see the bottom.
I pull the sand from under your feet.
The ground you stand on is shallowing.
I am on your left.
The water on the right is moving too.
That is only a back current.
I flick a fin and strike your waist.
The seawater comes with me.

lines.zh: 爆风一样的涡流在你脚边转。
lines.en: A whirlpool turns at your feet.
That is my move.
You can no longer stand.
I butt your knee from the water.
You drop to your knees in the sand.
The whirlpool binds your legs.
You are dragged half a block.
The water surges to your chest.
You cannot hold your feet.

lines.zh: 我拍水，把浪推到你身上。
lines.en: I slap the water and push the wave at you.
A white layer rises on the sea.
I come up from the bottom.
I know this stretch of sea.

lines.zh: 海里没有刷怪蛋的规矩。
lines.en: The sea has no spawn egg rule.
I swim here on my own.
The tide is right.
The reef is slippery.
There is a line across the water.
That is the trail I left.
I raise half of myself out.
The seabed sand is moving.
I come up from beneath.
Hot water pours in; I sink away.

lines.zh: 我从浅滩翻下去，落进浪里。
lines.en: I tip off the shallows into the surf.
Water is my home; I do not fear it.

lines.zh: 水底一震，沙子全浮起来。
lines.en: The seabed jolts and the sand rises.
Something sharp sticks in my fin.
That spell stiffens my fins.

lines.zh: 海里捞不到东西，我越来越慢。
lines.en: Nothing to catch; I grow slower.

lines.zh: 雷落进海里，白光穿到我身上。
lines.en: Lightning enters the sea and runs through me.
The water is gone all at once.
